question: Add logtail and logtail.com as aliases of the Better Stack entity, so that the free-for.dev Logtail entry resolves to dev-services/better-stack?
why: Better Stack's unification page says Better Uptime and Logtail were rebranded as Uptime and Logs and describes Logs as the former Logtail; logtail.com redirects to betterstack.com/log-management after four redirects; an archived copy of Logtail's pricing page lists a free plan of 1 GB per month with 3-day retention, the figure free-for.dev gives, against 3 GB per month with 3-day retention on Better Stack's pricing page now. The entry is one product under a former name, not a separate offer, and its 1 GB figure is the superseded one. A lane cannot write registry/entities.tsv; dev-services/better-stack names Logtail in its notes after this unit's change, so a text search finds it.
